note: What a server sends to carry a client's view from one place to another. The header names the champion of the player it is sent to.

bits.name: fromWhereItIs
bits.note: Set where the view starts from where it already is rather than from the place below.

bits.name: unlock
bits.note: Set where the view is left free once it arrives.

bits.name: unknown
bits.note: Purpose undetermined; a server sends it clear.

fields.name: fromX
fields.note: Where the view starts, along one ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: fromY
fields.note: Where the view starts, in height, in world units.

fields.name: fromZ
fields.note: Where the view starts, along the other ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: toX
fields.note: Where the view ends, along one ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: toY
fields.note: Where the view ends, in height, in world units.

fields.name: toZ
fields.note: Where the view ends, along the other ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: travelTime
fields.note: How long the view takes to get there, in seconds. The view moves at an even speed over the distance along the ground.
